subject: Finalize demo window — single slot decision requested
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0500
Subject: Recap + next step: technical deep-dive (proposed slots)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can align engineering and security owners for a short technical deep-dive.

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary goals: measure inference latency with your 3k token prompts, confirm data isolation model for PHI ingestion, and validate prefix caching behavior for your bursty traffic.
- Stakeholders to include: Novus platform/ops + Redwood runtime engineer (we'll bring a runtime lead).

Next step: 30-min technical deep-dive where we demo a short workflow and validate the mutual action plan. Can you pick one of the two candidate times below? If neither work, propose a single 30-min window and we'll prioritize.

Proposed (ET):
- Tue 11/24, 9:30–10:00am ET
- Wed 11/25, 10:00–10:30am ET

Attachments: novus-mutual-action-plan.pdf (draft), call-notes-20261123.txt. Also dropping a link to a short runbook we can show in the session.

If you confirm one slot, we'll send a calendar invite and lock a short dedicated lab instance for the demo. If we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow we'll release the reserved window.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0123
https://redwood.ai

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: novus-ops@novushealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next step: technical deep-dive (proposed slots)

Diego — sorry, I had an urgent exec sync that ran long and missed this afternoon's follow-up. I'm still very interested but availability is tight this week.

Available windows (ET):
- Wed 11/25, 10:00–11:00am (I can do a 30-min slice within that)
- Fri 11/27, 2:00–4:00pm (best as a 30-min)

If possible please make it 30 minutes and include our Platform Director Tom Baker (tom.baker@novushealth.com). He needs to see the isolation model.

I'll wait for your confirmation.
Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Novus Health

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + next step: technical deep-dive (proposed slots)

Thanks for the quick note, Samantha — totally understand. We can do a tighter set of options to match your windows. Please confirm one of these by EOD tomorrow and we'll lock it for Novus:

Tighter options (ET, 30 min):
- Tue 11/24, 9:30–10:00am ET (we can still run a short dry-run)
- Wed 11/25, 10:00–10:30am ET (fits your stated window)
- Thu 11/26, 11:00–11:30am ET (alternate)

Links: calendar pickers: https://calendar.redwood.com/slots/rdw-4319 (pick slot)
Lab access / runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/novus/lab-access

Note: if Tom can only join some of the time, we can record the short demo and follow with a focused 15-min Q&A. If you confirm Wed 11/25 10:00–10:30 ET I'll add Tom to the calendar and provision the demo environment now.

Attachments: technical-runbook-draft.pdf (short checklist we'll follow during the 30-min).

If you prefer, I can also push a single 30-min hold to your calendar and release it after 24 hours if it's not confirmed — please let me know if that helps.

Best — Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, novus-ops@novushealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:52:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + next step: technical deep-dive (proposed slots)

Hi Samantha — quick note from our side: if Novus confirms a 30-min deep-dive by EOD Wednesday we'll reserve a short dedicated lab instance and an engineer to run the benchmark (no extra cost for the demo environment). We have a small pool of reserved demo slots next week and can prioritize you if you lock the slot now.

Diego — happy to own the logistics; Diego, can you hold Wed 11/25 10:00–10:30 ET for 24hrs and I'll escalate to engineering to prioritize provisioning once Samantha confirms?

Samantha — we want to make this frictionless for you. If any of the three slots won't work, tell us the single 30-min we should hold.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sales Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>

Subject: Re: Recap + next step: technical deep-dive (proposed slots)

Thanks, Diego and Marissa — appreciate the flexibility. Wed 11/25, 10:00–10:30am ET works for us. I'm adding Tom Baker to the invite now (he's available for that slice). Please send the calendar invite and the short runbook so we can share with our ops team before the meeting.

I'll expect the calendar invite and the quick checklist.

Best — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Novus Health
